line: Oh, I, I spy with my little eye I spy, I spy with my little eye Oh, I, I spy with my little eye I spy, I spy with my little eye (Ooh-ah) Oh, I...
vault_lines: I spy with my little eye
meaning: Kyle compares finding girls on Instagram who may not have large followings to the childhood game and popular book series I Spy, where the goal is to find hidden items.

line: I’m just chilling, smokin’ reefer Dropping codeine in a liter
meaning: Kodak notes that he is chilling while smoking weed and also drinking lean. “Lean” drink usually consisting of Promethazine with Codeine cough syrup, or “sizzurp”, Jolly Ranchers, Sprite and optionally ice, which is why people often drink it from styrofoam cups.

line: I’m just like DeRozan, if I shoot it, it goes in
vault_lines: I'm just like DeRozan, if I shoot it, it goes in
meaning: DeMar DeRozan is a professional basketball player and plays for the Toronto Raptors. With a career field goal percentage of near 50%, there’s no surprise that if he shoots it, it goes in.

line: My album so cold when it drop, it’s gonna be a motherfucking snow day
vault_lines: My album so cold when it drop, it's gonna be a motherfucking snow day
meaning: KYLE is referencing the as-of-yet untitled follow-up to SMYLE, expected to be released this summer. Not including this remix, 5 singles have already been released (Doubt It, Blame, iSpy, Want Me Bad and Nothing 2 Lose), although it is uncertain which tracks will actually make the album. During his interview with Zane Lowe that accompanied the Nothing 2 Lose premiere, he confirmed the album would include a love ballad with Alessia Cara, as well as two songs with Ty Dolla $ign. He also hinted that fans should expect a long tracklist.

line: I got more stripes than a Zebra
vault_lines: I got more stripes than a Zebra
meaning:
Kodak is known for his encounters with jail. “Stripes” is a bit ambiguous here, it could refer to lines of cocaine, Kodak’s clothing, or accolades in the streets.

A theory on why zebras have stripes states that one factor is that it keeps the animal cool. By stating that he has more stripes than a zebra, Kodak might be implying that he is extra cool.

line: I can see you through my Jim Maui shades, ayy
vault_lines: I can see you through my Jim Maui shades, ayy
meaning: Kodak Black decided to try and start flexing on people by referencing the glasses company, Maui Jim, which makes sunglasses that have a starting price of around $100. He switched the words Maui Jim to Jim Maui so that his rhyme scheme would work from Maui to Audi.

line: I put VV’s on your ear, ayy
vault_lines: I put VV’s on your ear, ayy
meaning: Whoever he is singing to, he wants to show them that there is a caring side to him as well. Therefore, he wants to show his affection for this girl by giving her VVS quality(near flawless) diamond earrings to show his love. At the same time, he also uses this to show off his wealth since earrings like these do not come at a cheap price

line: Super Duper Sniper gang, don’t get hit with the scope, kid, oh shit
vault_lines: Super Duper Sniper gang, don't get hit with the scope, kid, oh shit
meaning:
Kyle combines his Super Duper Crew and label Kodak founded, Sniper Gang to form Super Duper Sniper Gang.

Before Kyle rose to fame, he hailed from the LA-based collective, Super Duper Crew. It consisted of not only rappers, but photographers, graphic designers and managers. Their influence is heavily featured on Kyle’s first two albums, Beautiful Loser and Smyle.



Additionally, a scope is the “telescopic” device on a sniper that allows the shooter to better aim at their target from a far away distance.

line: When I pull up, I’m in a black Audi A8, ayy
vault_lines: When I pull up, I’m in a black Audi A8, ayy
meaning:
The Audi A8 is a high-end business car, which price is around 85,000 dollars.

The black A8 can make an elegant appeal, which is probably what Kodak is aiming for.

line: I’m a Gemini, she’s a Libra
vault_lines: I’m a Gemini, she’s a Libra
meaning: Kodak was born June 11 making his Zodiac sign Gemini, the Twins. Libras are born between September 23 and October 22. People’s Zodiac signs are said to have an effect on their personalties and their compatibility in relationships. Geminis and Libras are supposed to have good chemistry, as Geminis are supposed to be good communicators, while Libras are said to be very loving.

line: I got a selfie with Oprah, but I still ain’t gonna post it
vault_lines: I got a selfie with Oprah, but I still ain't gonna post it
meaning:
Kyle claims to have a selfie with talk show host Oprah Winfrey, but while most people would be excited to post a picture like that, he’s famous enough that he doesn’t need to.

In his verified annotation of the original line, Kyle makes it seem like it might be a joke, saying that he “has to go to Area 51 and get hella clearance for that.” But here he asserts that he does in fact have it, changing the line from “I just ain’t never post it” to “but I still ain’t gonna post it.”

line: I know when you text me girl, I don’t always reply
vault_lines: I know when you text me girl, I don't always reply
meaning:
In his verified annotation of this line in the original song, Kyle explains that he often doesn’t respond to texts and prefers to talk to people in real life.

I’m kind of spacey when it comes to that. I’m detached from my phone, even though it’s in my pocket currently. I live in like the realm of right now, right here. Sometimes I don’t even text my mom back. I just be like, “Oh I’m going to see her sometime. She’s my mom. I’m going to see her in person eventually.” I can’t just be glued to my phone like everybody else and texting and text you back. I’m a shitty texter, I’ll say that.

line: Well, you’re not an angel either, you can’t even fly
vault_lines: Well, you're not an angel either, you can't even fly
meaning:
While Kyle may not always answer this girl’s texts, he points out that she isn’t perfect either. An angel in this case means someone who is very kind and well behaved, but an angel is also a kind of spiritual figure, normally depicted with wings.



“Angel” is also the name of a track on Kyle’s King Wavy EP.

line: They freed Lil Kodak, the kids back let’s throw somethin’
vault_lines: I ain't cried since '01, they freed Lil Kodak, the kids back let's throw somethin'
meaning:
On June 5, 2017 Kodak was released from Broward County Jail after serving almost a month of his 364 day sentence for a parole violation after his 2016 conviction.

While free, he is still facing a felony charge in South Carolina over an alleged sexual assault.
However, Kyle deems his return a cause for celebration.
Evel Knievel is one of the most notorious stunt performers. He is most known for his motorcycle jumps, in which he successfully completed 75 jumps over the course of 15 years.

line: This went hella platinum, nigga, it was just a throwaway
vault_lines: This went hella platinum, nigga, it was just a throwaway
meaning:
Kyle changes this line from his original verse and mentions the success of a simple “throwaway” that charted 4th in the Billboard Top 100.

In his verified annotation of the original line, Kyle explained that he had originally planned to not put this on an album, but due to it’s success, he wanted to put it on there, thus changing this line.

line: I got tunnel vision and these niggas out of focus
vault_lines: I got tunnel vision and these niggas out of focus
meaning:
Kyle subtly changes this line from the original to shout out on of Kodak’s recent hit singles, “Tunnel Vision”. The song managed to reach number four on the Billboard Hot R&B/Hip-Hop chart.



Kyle also touches on the literal meaning of tunnel vision, where you don’t see anything except the what’s directly ahead.
